description: Searches dental job listings posted in the last 6 months by state, city, and/or employer (practice or DSO name). Returns practice, location, posted compensation (salary, daily rate, production %, signing bonus), benefits, posting date, and the original listing link. Relevant when a dentist is looking for a job, relocating, or wants comparable offers.

city.description: City name, e.g. Houston. Best combined with state.

employer.description: Practice or DSO name to match, e.g. Aspen or Heartland. Searches nationwide.

state.description: US state as a 2-letter postal code (e.g. TX, CA, DC). Full state names are also accepted.

name: search_dental_jobs
title: Search recent dental job listings
